{{Top|leg}}
'''Holomags''' were a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] form of entertainment similar to a [[Holobook/Legends|holobook]] and were found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Lysko Buelia]] was a holomag mogul who later became the commissioner of the [[Nuna-Ball League]]. Available holomags for purchase were [[Consumer Automata]],<ref name="HNNV53150">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref> [[Hot Ships]], [[Kuat Classics]],<ref name="Red Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref> and [[Popular Automaton]]<ref name="Droidguide">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>.
